statement: Dino 8 must support assigning geographic (latitude/longitude) and projected GIS coordinate systems to a drawing, distinct from UCS/WCS, so model points can be transformed to positions on the Earth's surface including datum and projection effects.

acceptance.sketch: Assign a projected coordinate system to a drawing, place a point, and assert its transformed latitude/longitude matches the reference value from the projection definition.

notes: Added from help page "About GIS Coordinate Systems"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must display a temporary online map (aerial imagery or road map styles) behind all drawing objects in a viewport of a geo-located drawing when the user is signed in, covering the extent of the assigned GIS coordinate system and excluded from plotting.

acceptance.sketch: In a geo-located drawing signed in, turn the online map on and assert it renders behind objects; plot the layout and assert the map is not in the output; sign out and assert the map is not displayed.

notes: Added from help page "About the Online Map"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must create persistent map image objects by capturing the online map from the current view, a layout viewport or a rectangular area, positioned at the correct geographic coordinates and kept lowest in the draw order, plottable and viewable offline, and refreshable or re-resolutioned from the map service on demand.

acceptance.sketch: Capture a rectangular area of the online map, sign out, and assert the map image still displays and plots; update it and assert imagery is refreshed from the service.

notes: Added from help page "About Map Images"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must provide position markers, annotations of a point, leader and multiline text marking a geographic location, sized at creation by GEOMARKPOSITIONSIZE, adjustable by multi-functional grips and the Properties palette, with a zoom-invariant indicator, a searchable text and a notes property not shown in the drawing.

acceptance.sketch: Create a position marker with text 'Tower A' and notes, assert it can be found with FIND by its text, that notes appear in Properties but not on screen, and that resizing via Properties changes its size.

notes: Added from help page "About Position Markers"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must let a subscriber upload a view as a shared view with a link, viewable and commentable by others in a browser viewer without the product installed, expiring by default after 30 days, with comments managed from within the product.

acceptance.sketch: Create a shared view, open its link in a browser without the product, post a comment, and assert the owner is notified and sees the comment in a palette.

notes: Added from help page "About Shared Views"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must save and open drawings in the user's cloud account so they can be viewed and edited from desktop, web and mobile devices.

acceptance.sketch: Save a drawing to the cloud account, then open it from the web app and assert the content matches.

notes: Added from help page "About Accessing Drawings Remotely"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.
